WITH customer_data AS ( SELECT T1.CustomerID, T1.Date, T1.Amount, T1.Price, T2.Consumption AS consumption_2012, T3.Consumption AS consumption_2013 FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID AND T1.Date LIKE '2012%' INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T3 ON T1.CustomerID = T3.CustomerID AND T1.Date LIKE '2013%' WHERE T1.Date = '2012-08-25' AND T1.Amount = 634.8 ) SELECT (consumption_2012 - consumption_2013) / consumption_2012 AS consumption_decrease_rate FROM customer_data

WITH customer_consumption AS ( SELECT T1.CustomerID, T2.Date, T2.Consumption FROM customers AS T1 JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T2.Date = '2012-08-25' ) SELECT ( ( SELECT Consumption FROM customer_consumption WHERE Date = '2012-08-25' ) - ( SELECT Consumption FROM customer_consumption WHERE Date = '2013-08-25' ) ) / ( SELECT Consumption FROM customer_consumption WHERE Date = '2012-08-25' ) AS consumption_decrease_rate

WITH customer_transactions AS ( SELECT t.CustomerID, t.Date, SUM(t.Amount) AS total_amount FROM transactions_1k t WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25' AND t.Amount = 634.8 GROUP BY t.CustomerID ) SELECT ym1.Consumption AS consumption_2012, ym2.Consumption AS consumption_2013, (ym1.Consumption - ym2.Consumption) / ym1.Consumption AS consumption_decrease_rate FROM yearmonth ym1 JOIN yearmonth ym2 ON ym1.CustomerID = ym2.CustomerID WHERE ym1.Date = '201208' AND ym2.Date = '201308' AND ym1.CustomerID IN ( SELECT CustomerID FROM customer_transactions )

WITH RankedSchools AS ( SELECT s.CDSCode, s.SchoolType, s.SOCType, s.EILName, s.GSserved, s.Virtual, AVG(ss.AvgScrRead) AS AvgReadingScore, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.CountyName ORDER BY AVG(ss.AvgScrRead) DESC) AS Rank FROM schools s JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds WHERE s.Virtual = 'F' GROUP BY s.CDSCode, s.SchoolType, s.SOCType, s.EILName, s.GSserved, s.Virtual ) SELECT CDSCode, SchoolType, SOCType, EILName, GSserved, Virtual, AvgReadingScore FROM RankedSchools WHERE Rank <= 5

WITH RankedSchools AS (
  SELECT
    s.School,
    s.County,
    AVG(ss.AvgScrRead) AS AvgReadingScore,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.County ORDER BY AVG(ss.AvgScrRead) DESC) AS Rank
  FROM
    schools s
  JOIN
    satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
  WHERE
    s.Virtual = 'F'
  GROUP BY
    s.School, s.County
)
SELECT
  School
FROM
  RankedSchools
WHERE
  Rank <= 5;

SELECT s.School FROM frpm f JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds JOIN schools sch ON f.CDSCode = sch.CDSCode WHERE sch.Virtual = 'F' PARTITION BY f.County Name ORDER BY f.Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12) DESC LIMIT 5

WITH RankedSchools AS (
  SELECT
    s.CDSCode,
    s.SchoolType,
    s.CountyName,
    AVG(ss.AvgScrRead) AS AvgReadingScore
  FROM
    schools s
  JOIN
    satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
  WHERE
    s.Virtual = 'F'
  GROUP BY
    s.CDSCode, s.SchoolType, s.CountyName
)
SELECT
  rs.SchoolType,
  rs.CountyName,
  rs.AvgReadingScore
FROM
  RankedSchools rs
ORDER BY
  rs.CountyName,
  rs.AvgReadingScore DESC
LIMIT 5;
